```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Objective
This is just to filter a subset on images that are not already processed with tissue_vs_glass 
and generate a file_path file for it to read it in to QuPath

## Input
- subset_<subset>.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset)

## Output
- <subset>_unprocessed.txt
```{r}
subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_grading_sample.json")
subset_image_names <- subset$image_name
tissue_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/"

processed_files <- list.files(path = tissue_dir, full.names = FALSE)

unprocessed_images <- subset_image_names[
  !vapply(subset_image_names, function(x) any(startsWith(processed_files, x)), logical(1))
]

subset_unprocessed <- subset %>% filter(image_name %in% unprocessed_images)

subset_unprocessed_file_paths <- subset_unprocessed$file_path

writeLines(subset_unprocessed_file_paths, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/unprocessed/subset_grading_sample_unprocessed.txt")

```
